fee_notes: Fixed $10,000 Initial Franchise Fee plus $10,000 Integration Fee (both non-refundable). In 2024, franchisees paid Initial Franchise Fees ranging from $0 to $10,000 due to incentive programs. Development Fee = $10,000 per shop committed under Development Agreement, credited against Initial Franchise Fee at opening.
raw_excerpt: You must pay to us an "Initial Franchise Fee" of $10,000 in a lump sum when you sign the Franchise Agreement. In 2024, franchisees paid Initial Franchise Fees ranging from $0 to $10,000.
